indulge in chocolate: After a hard week of exams, I sometimes indulge in chocolate while watching my favorite movies.
在辛苦的考試週之後，我有時會一邊看最喜歡的電影，一邊放縱地吃巧克力。
indulge a child: Grandparents often indulge a child by giving in to every request for toys, candy, and late nights.
祖父母常常寵溺小孩，對玩具、糖果和晚睡的每個要求都讓步。
indulge oneself: After finishing her final exams, Lisa decided to indulge herself by buying the expensive shoes she wanted.
期末考結束後，麗莎決定犒賞自己，買下她想要的那雙昂貴鞋子。
indulge in fantasy: Instead of facing his problems, Mark would often indulge in fantasy about becoming rich and famous overnight.
馬克常常不去面對自己的問題，反而沉迷於一夜致富成名的幻想。
infect others with enthusiasm: Our new music teacher can infect others with enthusiasm, and soon the whole class wanted to join the choir.
我們的新音樂老師能以熱情感染他人，很快全班都想加入合唱團。
infect a computer: Clicking on a link in a strange email can infect a computer with a virus that steals your passwords.
點擊陌生電子郵件中的連結可能會讓電腦感染竊取密碼的病毒。
be infected with: Nearly half of the students were infected with the flu, so the school closed for three days.
將近一半的學生感染了流感，所以學校停課三天。
infectious laughter: Her infectious laughter filled the classroom, and soon even the serious teacher was smiling too.
她那有感染力的笑聲充滿了教室，很快連那位嚴肅的老師也笑了。
inflate prices: Some shops inflate prices before a typhoon because they know people will rush to buy food and water.
有些商店在颱風前哄抬價格，因為他們知道人們會搶購食物和水。
inflate one's ego: All the praise from fans only inflated his ego, and he began to think he was better than everyone else.
粉絲的讚美只讓他的自我膨脹，他開始覺得自己比其他人都優秀。
inflate the figures: The manager was caught trying to inflate the figures to make the company's profits look bigger than they were.
經理被抓到試圖灌水數據，讓公司的利潤看起來比實際更多。
inflate a balloon: My little brother used all his breath to inflate a balloon for his friend's birthday party.
我弟弟用盡全身的力氣為朋友的生日派對吹氣球。
inform the police: If you see someone acting strangely near the school gate, you should inform the police right away.
如果你看到有人在校門口附近行為怪異，你應該立刻報警。
inform one's decision: Reading reviews from other students helped inform my decision about which university to apply to.
閱讀其他學生的評價為我決定申請哪所大學提供了依據。
inform on someone: He refused to inform on his best friend, even when the teacher promised that he wouldn't be punished.
即使老師保證他不會受罰，他還是拒絕告發他最好的朋友。
keep someone informed: Please keep me informed about your travel plans so I know when to pick you up at the airport.
請隨時告知我你的旅行計畫，這樣我才知道什麼時候去機場接你。
informed choice: Before signing up for the phone plan, read all the details so you can make an informed choice.
在申辦手機方案之前，先把所有細節讀完，這樣你才能做出知情的選擇。
inherit a fortune: After her rich uncle passed away, she was lucky to inherit a fortune and used part of it to build a library.
她有錢的叔叔過世後，她幸運地繼承了一筆財產，並用其中一部分蓋了一座圖書館。
inherit a problem: Every new manager seems to inherit a problem from the last one, such as a team that keeps missing deadlines.
每位新經理似乎都會從前任手上接手爛攤子，例如一個老是錯過期限的團隊。
inherit one's father's temper: Jason seems to inherit his father's temper, because he gets angry easily when things don't go his way.
傑森似乎遺傳了他父親的脾氣，因為事情不如他意時他就很容易生氣。
inherit the title: As the oldest son of the king, the prince will inherit the title when his father dies.
身為國王的長子，王子將在父親過世後繼承頭銜。
inhibit growth: Too little sunlight and poor soil can inhibit growth, so the plants in the corner stayed very small.
日照太少和土壤貧瘠會抑制成長，所以角落裡的植物一直長得很小。
inhibit creativity: Too many strict rules can inhibit creativity and make students afraid to try new ideas in class.
太多嚴格的規定會壓抑創造力，讓學生在課堂上害怕嘗試新點子。
feel inhibited: Many students feel inhibited when speaking English in front of the class because they fear making mistakes.
許多學生在全班面前說英文時會感到拘束，因為他們害怕犯錯。
inhibit the reaction: The scientist added a special chemical to inhibit the reaction so that the mixture would not get too hot.
科學家加入一種特殊化學物質來抑制反應，好讓混合物不會變得太燙。
initiate a conversation: Shy students may find it hard to initiate a conversation with someone they have never met before.
害羞的學生可能會覺得很難和從未見過的人開啟對話。
initiate reforms: The new principal plans to initiate reforms that will give students more choice in their courses.
新校長計畫發起改革，讓學生在課程上有更多選擇。
initiate legal action: The singer decided to initiate legal action against the website that used her songs without permission.
那位歌手決定對未經允許使用她歌曲的網站提起訴訟。
be initiated into: New members are initiated into the club with a special ceremony on their first night.
新成員在第一晚會透過特別的儀式被引進入社。
